dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Stars cast from the celestial tapestry are the final moments of an hourglass.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Tremors erupting from the earth are the dying echoes of an ancient god's heart.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Shall I usher in this world's desolate finale with none save my own shadow?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: You... Would you accompany me to witness this world's end and greet the descension of eternal night?

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: What mein Fräulein means to say is...

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Very good! Allow me to offer resplendent blessings to illuminate your fated travels!

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Along with my familiar of the night, Ozvaldo Hrafnavins, will safeguard your path ahead, for fate has revealed to me that this be decreed!

choices.text: I will be at your side.
